home.heroTitle: SUPER fresh pies, pastries made with love
home.heroBody: From golden pies to custom cakes and hands-on baking classes, SUPER Chris Pies and Pastries brings warm, homemade flavour to every order.
home.storyHeading: IT STARTED WITH A LOVE FOR BAKING
home.storyP1: SUPER Chris Pies and Pastries is a Kenyan bakery built on simple joy: fresh ingredients, careful hands, and recipes that make people feel at home.
home.storyP2: We specialise in pies, pastries, custom cakes, and practical baking classes for anyone who wants to learn the craft. Every order is prepared with care and confirmed personally on WhatsApp.
home.storyP3: Whether you need a quick treat with chai, a custom cake for a celebration, or a class to sharpen your baking skills, we are here to make it warm, tasty, and memorable.
home.specialCaption: A taste of what we bake with love. Fresh pies, flaky pastries, and custom treats made for everyday moments and special celebrations.
home.howToOrderCaption: Ordering is simple and personal. We confirm every detail on WhatsApp so your order comes out just right.
home.step1Body: Browse our menu, gallery, or tell us what you have in mind for a custom order.
home.step2Body: Tap any order button and send your details. We will confirm availability, price, and timing.
home.step3Body: Pick up or arrange delivery where available. Every order is prepared fresh with care.
home.classesTeaserBody: Join a hands-on baking class and learn how to make pies, pastries, and beautiful cake finishes from scratch. Beginner friendly, practical, and fun.
home.galleryCaption: Real bakes, real moments, and real class experiences from SUPER Chris Pies and Pastries.

footer.about: Kenyan bakery specialising in pies, pastries, custom cakes and hands-on baking classes. Freshly made with love.
footer.copyright: SUPER Chris Pies and Pastries. All rights reserved.
footer.warmLine: Baked with love, shared with joy.

voice.text: Welcome to SUPER Chris Pies and Pastries. We are a Kenyan bakery specialising in fresh pies, pastries, custom cakes, and hands-on baking classes. Browse our menu to order your favourites on WhatsApp, explore custom orders for celebrations, or book a baking class to learn the craft. You can also reach us by email at superchrispiesandpastries at gmail dot com. We look forward to baking something special for you.
